title: AgriDesign: Design and Analysis of Agricultural Experiments (R package)
description: R package for the design and analysis of agricultural experiments: analysis of variance of 16 classical designs with the right error strata, assumption checks, transformations and rank-based alternatives, mean separation with eleven procedures and compact letters, simple effects, trends and contrasts, recovery of inter-block information by REML, randomised field layouts with field books, efficiency factors and power, publication figures and HTML reports, plant breeding analyses (AMMI, stability, line x tester, diallel, North Carolina designs) and plant pathology tools (AUDPC, AUDPS, soil heterogeneity). Base R only. Every statistic is validated against independent implementations.
